mapper.select: SELECT r.RESERVATION_ID, r.USER_ID, r.ASSET_ID, r.START_TIME, r.END_TIME, r.PURPOSE, r.STATUS, r.ADDRESS, r.ADDRESS_STATE, r.ADDRESS_CITY, r.CREATED_AT, r.UPDATED_AT, a.NAME as ASSET_NAME, a.CATEGORY as ASSET_CATEGORY, a.COMPANY as ASSET_COMPANY, a.IMAGE as ASSET_IMAGE FROM RESERVATION r JOIN ASSET a ON r.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID WHERE r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.IS_DELETED = '0' ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT r.RESERVATION_ID, r.USER_ID, r.ASSET_ID, r.START_TIME, r.END_TIME, r.PURPOSE, r.STATUS, r.ADDRESS, r.ADDRESS_STATE, r.ADDRESS_CITY, r.CREATED_AT, r.UPDATED_AT, a.NAME as ASSET_NAME, a.CATEGORY as ASSET_CATEGORY, a.COMPANY as ASSET_COMPANY, a.IMAGE as ASSET_IMAGE FROM RESERVATION r JOIN ASSET a ON r.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID WHERE r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.IS_DELETED = '0' AND r.CREATED_AT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT r.RESERVATION_ID, r.USER_ID, r.ASSET_ID, r.START_TIME, r.END_TIME, r.PURPOSE, r.STATUS, r.ADDRESS, r.ADDRESS_STATE, r.ADDRESS_CITY, r.CREATED_AT, r.UPDATED_AT, a.NAME as ASSET_NAME, a.CATEGORY as ASSET_CATEGORY, a.COMPANY as ASSET_COMPANY, a.IMAGE as ASSET_IMAGE FROM RESERVATION r JOIN ASSET a ON r.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID WHERE r.RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.IS_DELETED = '0'

SELECT ul.USAGE_LOG_ID, ul.RESERVATION_ID, ul.USER_ID, ul.ASSET_ID, ul.START_TIME, ul.END_TIME, ul.USAGE_DURATION, ul.USAGE_STATUS, ul.PROCESSED_BY, ul.CREATED_AT, ul.UPDATED_AT, r.PURPOSE, r.STATUS as RESERVATION_STATUS, a.NAME as ASSET_NAME, a.CATEGORY as ASSET_CATEGORY, a.COMPANY as ASSET_COMPANY, a.IMAGE as ASSET_IMAGE, u.NAME as PROCESSED_BY_NAME FROM USAGE_LOG ul JOIN RESERVATION r ON ul.RESERVATION_ID = r.RESERVATION_ID JOIN ASSET a ON ul.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID LEFT JOIN USERS u ON ul.PROCESSED_BY = u.USER_ID WHERE ul.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.IS_DELETED = '0' ORDER BY ul.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as TOTAL_USAGE, SUM(CASE WHEN ul.USAGE_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as COMPLETED_USAGE, SUM(CASE WHEN ul.USAGE_DURATION IS NOT NULL THEN ul.USAGE_DURATION ELSE 0 END) as TOTAL_DURATION, COUNT(DISTINCT ul.ASSET_ID) as UNIQUE_ASSETS FROM USAGE_LOG ul JOIN ASSET a ON ul.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID WHERE ul.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.IS_DELETED = '0'

SELECT COUNT(*) as TOTAL_RESERVATIONS, SUM(CASE WHEN r.STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as PENDING_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN r.STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as APPROVED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN r.STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as REJECTED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN r.STATUS = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as CANCELLED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN r.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as COMPLETED_COUNT FROM RESERVATION r JOIN ASSET a ON r.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID WHERE r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.IS_DELETED = '0'

SELECT DISTINCT a.ASSET_ID, a.NAME as ASSET_NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY, a.IMAGE, MAX(ul.CREATED_AT) as LAST_USED FROM USAGE_LOG ul JOIN ASSET a ON ul.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID WHERE ul.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.IS_DELETED = '0' GROUP BY a.ASSET_ID, a.NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY, a.IMAGE ORDER BY LAST_USED DESC
FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
